description: Get one card by its card_id (for example to refresh its price or resolve a stored id). 0.5 credits when the card exists, nothing for an unknown card. For a wrong detection use search_cards with request_id and correct_card instead: those are free. Football and basketball: pass the ref of a search_cards result (same API key, within 24 hours); the card then comes with all parallels of its subset and their print runs. Without a valid ref the call is refused and free. Not for Riftbound (detection only).

card_id.description: card_id (Yu-Gi-Oh!: passcode; Magic: oracle_id; SWU: printing id or card_key; Digimon: dg-... printing id, dg-c-<number> or the bare number BT1-025; Cyberpunk: cp-... printing id, cp-c-<card_key> or the bare card key v-streetkid; football: fb-...; basketball: bk-...).

cardmarket_id.description: One Piece: picks a parallel printing. Pokémon: a possible_variants cardmarket_id of that card picks the special version (any other id: 400 unsupported_cardmarket_id).

language.description: Card language, e.g. en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, zh (per game; Digimon en or ja; Cyberpunk en or fr). Default: the detected card's language, else en. Leave it out for football and basketball.

number.description: Magic, SWU: collector number of the printing.

ref.description: Football and basketball only, required there: the ref of the search_cards result for this card_id (valid 24 hours).

reverse_holo.description: Pokémon only: true returns the reverse holo price.

set.description: Magic, SWU: set of the printing; Yu-Gi-Oh!: the printed code.

tcg.description: Game of the card. Riftbound is not in the card search.

name: get_card
title: Get one card by id
